synopsis: When a group of people with disabilities in Bolivia unite in protest for a pension, they never imagined what was to come… Trekking the Andes in their wheelchairs, they’re forced to confront a government that tries to silence them and a society indifferent to their struggle.

quotes.raw: "This is a hell of a tale. It’s a magnificent tale about the fight for what is right. I was moved." - Steve Kopian, UNSEEN FILMS

quotes.raw: "The heroes featured here show the full swath of how a fight like this can both elevate and break down the human spirit and makes 'The Fight' be a title with two meanings; the fight against the system, and the fight to not give up." - Juan.J Arroyo, ROLLINGSTONE

synopsis: People with disabilities are among the most discriminated against in Bolivia. Fed up of being ignored, a group of them marched across the Andes to the seat of the Government in La Paz, asking to speak with President Evo Morales. They are met with riot police, barricades, tear gas and water cannons.

synopsis: Flying out of Bolivia, three Norwegian teenaged girls are arrested with 22 kg of cocaine in their luggage. Thrown in jail, the young, beautiful girls immediately became tabloid fodder back home. Combining the juiciest elements of reality TV and true-crime pulp fiction, The Bolivian Case is a sensational criminal exposé that sheds light on the increasing malleability of modern crime and punishment.

quotes.raw: “Las Awichas by Violeta Ayala offers a thoughtful use of AI and XR from a much-needed Indigenous perspective. The work proposes enchanting interactions with mystical, yet technological animal spirits and Quechua cosmology. The superposition of AR amulets on matriarchal portraits bridges the ancestral to the present. Activated on the body, these become intimate experiences that evoke a resonant world we wanted to return to.”
